plastic_bag_film.recommended_handling: Keep separate from recyclable materials and dispose of through the appropriate general-waste or soft-plastic collection stream where available.

cigarette.recommended_handling: Ensure the cigarette is fully extinguished and dispose of it securely in the general-waste stream.

small_accessory.recommended_handling: Collect small accessories securely and place them in the appropriate general-waste stream unless a specific recycling facility accepts them.

scrap_metal.recommended_handling: Keep separate from general waste and deliver to an appropriate metal recycling or scrap collection facility.

plastic_bottle.recommended_handling: Empty, rinse, and place in an appropriate plastic recycling stream.

drink_can.recommended_handling: Empty, rinse, and place in an appropriate metal recycling stream.

other_plastic.recommended_handling: Dispose of through the appropriate general-waste stream unless the specific plastic type is accepted by a local recycling facility.

paper.recommended_handling: Keep clean and dry and place in an appropriate paper recycling stream.

glass.recommended_handling: Separate carefully and place in a designated glass recycling stream. Handle broken glass safely.

cardboard_carton.recommended_handling: Keep clean and dry, flatten when possible, and place in an appropriate paper and cardboard recycling stream.

disposable_utensils_straw.recommended_handling: Place used disposable utensils and straws in the appropriate general-waste stream.

disposable_plastic_container.recommended_handling: Empty and rinse the container before placing it in an appropriate plastic recycling stream.

foam_styrofoam.recommended_handling: Keep separate from recyclable materials and dispose of through the appropriate general-waste stream unless a specialised collection facility is available.

general_waste.recommended_handling: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste collection stream.

rope_strings.recommended_handling: Bundle or contain loose rope and strings securely before placing them in the appropriate general-waste stream.

food_waste.recommended_handling: Keep separate from recyclable materials. Use composting or an organic-waste collection stream where available; otherwise use the appropriate general-waste stream.

food_wrapper.recommended_handling: Place the wrapper in the appropriate general-waste stream unless its material is specifically accepted by a local recycling facility.

dirty_tissue.recommended_handling: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste stream.

used_diaper.recommended_handling: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste stream.

contaminated_packaging.recommended_handling: Place in the appropriate general-waste stream when it cannot be emptied and cleaned for recycling.

electronic_waste.recommended_handling: Do not place electronic waste in normal recycling bins. Keep it dry and intact and deliver it to an authorised electronic-waste collection or recovery facility.

battery.recommended_handling: Do not place batteries in household recycling or general-waste bins. Keep terminals protected where appropriate and deliver them to an authorised battery or electronic-waste collection point.

sofa.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or furniture recovery service.

mattress.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or mattress recovery service.

large_table.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an appropriate bulky-waste or furniture recovery service.

refrigerator.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an authorised bulky-waste or appliance recovery service.

washing_machine.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an authorised bulky-waste or appliance recovery service.

large_appliance.recommended_handling: Arrange collection through an authorised bulky-waste or appliance recovery service.
